title: Local-state policy
responsibility: Decide and enforce where session transcripts, consent records, compatibility results and setup journals live: by default under the outer project's ignored `.pi/sessions/` and `.pi/runtime/`, or, when explicitly selected, under an external per-user root derived from the committed non-secret project ID. Refuse to write any runtime data before the chosen location's protection is in place, and never commit an absolute user path in order to reach it.
notes: ⚠️ THE EXTERNAL MODE IS NO LONGER CONDITIONAL — three relocation routes were proved on both platforms (AST-0047), so `--session-dir` supplied at launch reaches an external root without committing an absolute path. ⚠️ THE FIVE PERSISTED SHAPES ARE NOW SPECIFIED AND VALIDATED (DEC-0033), which is what stage 5's data-model criterion was waiting on: each has a schema, a per-record version, a declared location, a committed/ignored classification, and refusals for the credential material and absolute home paths REQ-0024 forbids. What is specified is the SHAPE; the code that writes them is still the setup transaction's work.
